scientific_integrity: Analytic stopped-diffusion moment equations and exact Poisson renewal identity; algebraic checks are supplementary. No globally optimal rate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is local as the Poisson rate decreases to zero, not an all-rate optimum; the Brownian noises are equally diffusive with correlation strictly between -1 and 1, with simultaneous complete no-duration resets. The independent publication-priority review, finite-sample identifiability, costs and experimental validation are not performed.
title: Correlation–geometry boundary for weak resetting of paired Brownian searchers
